spans.s: + अङ्कुर रद- + अङ्कुर, m. the point of a tooth.
+ छद रद- + छद and रदन-, m. a lip.

. To split, to divide.
 2. To dig.
 --Cf. probably Goth. lêtan; A.S. laetan (cf. the vedic use of रद्); Lat. rādere, rōdere (cf. रद, रदन), perhaps rădius.

रद् + अ, m.
 1. Splitting, Ghaṭ. 1.
 2. A tooth.
 --Comp.
रदिन्, i. e. रद + इन्, m. An elephant.
